Which policies are the claims of ‹claima.plan:
Claimant to claim is the FILED_BY relationship in reverse (claim -> claimant), and claim to policy is UNDER_POLICY (claim -> policy). The path runs through the claim type, so its two hops go in different directions: first in, then out.

The linked-entities template says that one direction applies to all hops. It also says that when the relationship type leading the path already joins the anchor to entities of the target type, the question must be refused. That condition does not hold here: FILED_BY joins the claimant to claims, not to policies, so the anchor has no neighbors of the target type that would leak into the result. Even so, one direction cannot cover both hops. With "both", the result could include other paths, such as a claimant reaching a policy through some other route. The vocabulary has no such route, since only claims link to policies and claimants link to claims.

With direction "both" and via [FILED_BY, UNDER_POLICY], two hops from the claimant run as follows:
- Hop 1 reaches the claims through FILED_BY.
- Hop 2 reaches the policies through UNDER_POLICY.
- Other hop-2 routes from the claims, such as FILED_BY back to claimants, do not produce policies.
- One-hop results of the target type are not possible, because the claimant has no direct link to a policy.

So the plan is safe, and "both" gives the right answer.

